caption: About 1 minute 16 seconds after we started, the public booking page listed both test services, open to clients without a login.
A test appointment for a test client sat in the week calendar about 2 minutes after we started; we switched off the client notification first.
Monthly plans: Booking 59.90 EUR, Booking + Marketing 79.90 EUR and All in One 129.90 EUR; our trial ran on All in One.
Choosing Booking yearly led to an order of 598.80 EUR, with a note that SMS features are charged separately. We stopped here.
